78514.subject: Robinhood Chain Base Fee Climbed By 23x
78514.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[Robinhood Chain](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/robinhood-chain-gas-fees-jump-82-fold-in-11-days-to-top-every-other-chain)**[ users paid $4.45M in gas, topping every chain](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/robinhood-chain-gas-fees-jump-82-fold-in-11-days-to-top-every-other-chain)

* **[Bitcoin](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-retakes-80000-after-waller-signals-a-hold)**[ retook $80,000 after Waller signaled a hold](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-retakes-80000-after-waller-signals-a-hold)

* **[Trading terminals](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/trading-terminals-post-first-usd1-billion-day-since-january-2025)**[ cleared their first $1B day since January 2025](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/trading-terminals-post-first-usd1-billion-day-since-january-2025)

* **[Uniswap Labs](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/uniswap-labs-bought-pons-token-for-long-term-alignment)**[ bought PONS four weeks after launching a rival](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/uniswap-labs-bought-pons-token-for-long-term-alignment)

* **[LIT](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/lighter-lit-perp-dex-token-rally-robinhood-volume)**[ rose 13% and has doubled in 30 days](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/lighter-lit-perp-dex-token-rally-robinhood-volume)

Robinhood Chain collected $4.45 million in gas fees on Tuesday, more than Ethereum, Solana and Tron combined.

Eleven days earlier the network took in roughly $54,000. The base fee has since climbed to 23 times its 0.02 gwei floor as memecoin and tokenized-stock flow filled block space, and Robinhood is [absorbing the cost inside its own wallet app until Sept. 29](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/robinhood-chain-gas-fees-jump-82-fold-in-11-days-to-top-every-other-chain), so Robinhood is funding the record its users are setting.

A chain out-earning Ethereum while one company pays its users' fees has a revenue line with an expiry date. The repricing has already spread down the stack to Pons, to LIT and to a terminal business that just cleared its first billion-dollar day since January 2025. On Sept. 29 the subsidy stops, and the market finds out how much of this volume was ever price-sensitive.

**Read more below!**

———————————————————————————

———————————————————————————

##### WATCH

## Can Robinhood Chain Take This Boom? w/ Arbitrum’s Steven Goldfeder

Robinhood Chain is out-earning every other blockchain on fees, and Arbitrum co-founder Steven Goldfeder built the stack it runs on. He takes the questions the fee chart raises: whether the tokenization and memecoin volume has legs, what spiking fees do to the users paying them, and where decentralization sits when Robinhood picks up the gas bill. [**Watch the full conversation.**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RL6C0CJNyhs)

Youtube: 🟢 LIVE: Can RobinHood Chain Take This Boom?  w/ ARB's Steven Goldfeder (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RL6C0CJNyhs)

# Thursday links: Frankentokens, LSU, crypto cash flows, handbag hedge fund

[It’s alive!](https://x.com/BTCdayu/status/2094662511526338626?s=20)

Crypto is suddenly booming again, thanks to a Frankenstein combination of equities and tokens: “stock-paired memecoins.”

To take one popular example, people are trading the memecoin Artificial Inu (AI) in a liquidity pool where it’s paired with tokenized shares of Nvidia. To buy AI, you first have to buy NVDA. 

(In other words, AI is denominated in NVDA instead of the usual ETH or USDC.)

It’s difficult to say why exactly anyone would want to do that, but something about pairing thematically-aligned memes and stocks has captured the imagination of traders. Amid frantic trading, Artificial Inu has shot to a $250 million valuation.

The phenomenon is happening on Robinhood’s new layer-2 blockchain. Launched just two months ago, Robinhood Chain (RHC) has already hosted over 500 million transactions and $22 billion of DEX volume, according to [data](https://app.blockworksresearch.com/analytics/robinhood) from Blockworks Research.

Yesterday alone, the chain collected $4.6 million of network REV (the fees users pay to get their transactions included in a block).

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/b051021e-dfc0-4f94-b9f7-875c8fbe4f9a/image.png?t=1788470865)
Caption: 

By comparison, Solana collected only $700,000 of REV yesterday.

(Note: Gas fees on RHC have been as much as [128x higher](https://x.com/0xcarlosg/status/2095444848551633401?s=20) than on Solana, which I'm guessing won’t last long.) 

As with any good memecoin story, this can be intellectualized. As a trader on X explained,** “**Stocks provide what memes lack most — real-world value anchors and narratives; memes provide what stocks lack most — attention, community, virality, and speculative liquidity.”

78407.subject: AVALANCHE AUGUST 2026 RECAP
78407.body:
View this post on the web at https://www.team1.blog/p/avalanche-august-2026-recap

August was the month Wall Street started showing up on Avalanche in earnest. Charles Schwab added AVAX for its 40 million brokerage accounts, Dinari brought 724 tokenized U.S. stocks including the full S&P 500 to Avalanche investors, and POSCO International completed a proof of concept for tokenizing global trade receivables on the network.
At the same time, Team1 officially launched in Korea. With Avalanche Summit NYC less than three weeks away, September is shaping up to be a major moment for the ecosystem.
Here’s everything that happened in August.
Want to keep up with the latest in the Avalanche ecosystem? Subscribe to the Team1 blog and get our updates in your inbox weekly.
Tokenized Assets Grow Nearly 8x in a Year:
Tokenized assets on Avalanche climbed from $242 million to $1.93 billion over the past year, with Securitize now accounting for more than half of that value. [Growth [ https://substack.com/redirect/5fc6043c-d884-4242-90b9-611b3d9b8308?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Foundation Introduces Gross Chain Income:
The Avalanche Foundation published a new Gross Chain Income framework from Lead Economist Eric Lu, extending its Gross Chain Product work into a three-step model for measuring, capturing, and distributing value across the ecosystem. [GCI [ https://substack.com/redirect/92d16235-ee07-40f6-a010-1a719e9a302b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
RWA Transfer Volume Jumps 360% in 30 Days:
Avalanche’s RWA ecosystem recorded $365.29 million in 30-day transfer volume, up 360.15% from the prior month, spanning tokenized funds, equities, treasuries, and private credit. [Volume [ https://substack.com/redirect/183ebb6c-4c8e-4af8-ad57-0c24db4d6fce?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Team1 Korea Officially Launches:
Team1 Korea launched after onboarding more than 500 builders, 12 teams, 200-plus developers, and 80-plus founders, giving Korean talent a clearer path to build on Avalanche.
Team1 Chapters Stay Busy Across Five Continents:
Team1 chapters continued bringing Avalanche directly to local builders. August highlights included a builder workshop in Seoul focused on AI-agent payments, a meetup in Reggio Calabria, a Builder Connect at Oracle’s Bogotá offices, an L1 workshop in Türkiye, university activity in Vietnam, and multiple builder and community events across Brazil, India, Latin America, Nigeria and lots more.
New paths for funding and support opened up this month.
Team1 Opens Applications for ProtocolCamp Cohort 10:
Team1 called for builders to join ProtocolCamp Cohort 10, a 12-week program turning ideas into shipped products with travel covered and a kickoff during Korea Blockchain Week. [ProtocolCamp [ https://substack.com/redirect/484aea27-85f1-40c0-922a-43f8706045a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEW

Bringing global finance onchain



 
Highlights
 
Aave App Enters Early Access on iOS
Early access to the Aave App started on August 26 on iOS. The first cohort of users received Ghost Passes, which are invites that
let friends and family skip the waitlist. More passes are being given out through the Aave Instagram, Telegram, and on X.
Announcement here [https://x.com/aave/status/2092643144139424046].
 
Coinbase Tokenized Stocks Coming to V4
Coinbase Tokenized Stocks went live on Base, and Aave V4 will be the first credit market to fully support them. Once V4 is
deployed on Base, users will be able to borrow stablecoins against tokenized stocks. Only available in eligible geos outside the
U.S. Announcement here [https://x.com/aave/status/2091964981675704495].
 
Aave V4 Crosses $800M Deposits
Aave V4 crossed $800 million deposits on August 27, while active loans set a new all-time high. Announcement here
[https://x.com/aave/status/2093013562788598243].
 
New incentives are also live for USDC borrowers [https://x.com/aave/status/2094433298567090579] in the Core Hub on Ethereum.
Borrow USDC against any available collateral and earn 2% back in USDC rewards.
 
EtherFi Cash Now Runs on V4
EtherFi moved its Cash credit backend to a dedicated Aave V4 instance on Optimism, letting more than 100,000 cardholders borrow
against their portfolios. Supported collateral includes PAXG, SPYx, WBTC, ETH, and ETHFI, with more coming as the integration
expands. Deposits on the deployment crossed $100 million in its first week. Announcement here
[https://x.com/aave/status/2088265181230969095].
